title: OpenPlanr design-loop session (v1.0.0)
description: One variant's generation lineage, persisted as session-<variant>.json in the session dir (user space, ~/.planr/designs/<project>/<target>-<date>/) — NOT /tmp, so a session can be revisited. For provider=openai, lastResponseId chains the Responses API so `iterate` refines instead of regenerating. For provider=claude-svg the chain is the file itself (the agent edits the artifact); lastResponseId stays null.

provider.description: Which provider owns this session's generation chain.

target.description: What is being designed: logo, brand-sheet, screen, og-image, …

project.description: Project slug the exploration belongs to.

briefVersions.description: Every brief revision, oldest→newest (the original is index 0).

feedbackHistory.description: The feedback text applied at each iterate round, oldest→newest.

outputPaths.description: Absolute artifact path per round, oldest→newest (last = current).

regionEdits.description: Pin-driven edits applied to this session (design-review rounds).

at.description: ISO timestamp of the edit round.

screen.description: Screen/section id the round targeted, when scoped.

pins.description: The pins (design-feedback shape) that drove the edit.

lastResponseId.description: openai provider: the Responses API id to chain via previous_response_id. null for claude-svg.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last round.
